dedupe_keys.name: matlab minimum ambulance numbers for alpha reliable coverage

description: This MATLAB model computes the minimum number of ambulances that must cover a demand area to attain a specified reliability. Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University publishes two scripts: one for a fixed target and one for targets ranging from one to ninety percent. The accompanying Data in Brief article uses their output in ambulance deployment inputs for the Fez-Meknes region of Morocco, supporting MALP and Q-MALP coverage formulations. Geographic coverage is that documented application; the scripts are static calculations, not time-stamped dispatch observations. Zenodo V1.0 is free under MIT, while the current linked GitHub repository reports CC0 1.0. The licence distinction is retained. The short README does not fully establish argument definitions or dependency requirements, a limitation for immediate execution. Modellers could calculate coverage constraints before testing fleet configurations in simulations. data-fez-meknes-ambulance-deployment supplies the associated input collection; model-jemss and model-openems-ambulance-deployment are related simulators. The source archive was not downloaded or run.
inputs: Demand-area parameters specified in supplied MATLAB scripts
